facilities.name: Central Fitness Gymnasium
facilities.maintenanceNotes: All 8 cardio machines and 14 strength stations functional. Sanitized every 3 hours.
rules: Proper gym attire and clean sports footwear mandatory.
Wipe down machines after use with provided sanitizing wipes.
Maximum 60 minutes session duration during peak hours.
Personal trainers from outside require prior RWA desk pass.

facilities.name: Emerald Central Park & Walking Loop
facilities.maintenanceNotes: Lawn trimmed on 18th Oct. Sprinklers run automatically 04:30 AM and 09:45 PM.
rules: Pets must be kept on short leashes at all times. Please scoop poop.
No cycling or skateboards on synthetic jogging loop.
Children under 8 must be accompanied by parents in the play area.

facilities.name: Badminton & Squash Sports Arena
facilities.maintenanceNotes: Court 1 operational; Court 2 net wire tension being tuned today.
rules: Strictly non-marking gum sole shoes only.
Court booking maximum 1 hour per flat per day.
Please switch off arena floodlights and AC if leaving last.

facilities.name: Table Tennis & Billiards Lounge
facilities.maintenanceNotes: 2 Stiga Pro TT tables and 1 English Slate Snooker table in mint condition.
rules: Return racquets, cues, and balls to the equipment locker after play.
Food and soft drinks not permitted near billiard cloth table.
Maximum 45 minutes table tenure if other residents are queued.

announcements.title: Emergency Booster Pump Line Pressure Testing – Tower 2
announcements.description: Hydrostatic pressure testing on the secondary booster riser between floors 15 and 25. Minor fluctuations in kitchen water pressure between 11:00 AM and 01:00 PM. Overhead tanks are fully topped up.

announcements.title: Annual General Body Meeting (AGM) 2026 – Final Voting & Budget Approval
announcements.description: The RWA Annual General Body Meeting will be held at the Rooftop Banquet Hall. Key voting on solar net-metering capital expenditure, audited society accounts, and intercom AMC renewal. High tea served for all attendees.

announcements.title: Rooftop Solar PV Net-Metering Commissioning & Grid Sync
announcements.description: BESCOM officials will complete final grid synchronization for our 120kW rooftop solar system. Expected reduction in common area energy charges by 42% starting this billing cycle.

announcements.title: Children Play Zone & Sandpit Rubber Flooring Upgradation
announcements.description: New anti-skid EPDM shock-absorbing safety tiles being laid in the toddler play section. Play area will partially reopen on Wednesday morning.

announcements.title: Water Supply Interruption & Overhead Tank Deep Cleaning Drive
announcements.description: Please note that main overhead reservoir cleaning and chlorination for Golden Towers 1, 2 & 3 will take place on Saturday, 25th October from 10:00 AM to 03:00 PM. Residents are requested to store adequate water for morning usage. Booster pumps will resume full pressure by 4:00 PM.

announcements.title: Annual General Body Meeting (AGM) 2026 & Financial Presentation
announcements.description: The RWA Management Committee cordially invites all flat owners and residents to the Annual General Body Meeting on Sunday, 8th November 2026 at 10:30 AM at the Rooftop Banquet Hall. The audited balance sheet and capital expenditure plans for solar roof expansion will be voted on. High tea provided.

announcements.title: Diwali Grand Festivities, Cultural Night & Food Stalls in Central Park
announcements.description: Celebrate Diwali with our community on Saturday, 31st October at Emerald Central Park! Cultural performances by resident children, musical night, eco-friendly diya lighting, and food stalls. Register your stall with the cultural subcommittee by 26th October.

announcements.title: Gymnasium Routine Equipment Maintenance - Sunday 02 PM to 05 PM
announcements.description: Routine quarterly servicing of treadmills, cross-trainers, and cable crossover systems is scheduled for Sunday, 26th October between 02:00 PM and 05:00 PM. Gymnasium will remain closed during this window for resident safety.

announcements.title: Reminder: October Maintenance Dues Final Grace Period Ends Oct 25th
announcements.description: Dear Residents, maintenance dues for October 2026 were payable by October 10th. Flats with pending dues are requested to clear payments via the resident portal before October 25th to avoid a 2% per month late levy.

announcements.title: Quarterly Fire Drill & Fire Hydrant Pressure Inspection
announcements.description: Mandatory mock evacuation drill conducted in coordination with the local Fire Station. Audible fire alarm sirens sounded for 3 minutes. All hose reels and wet risers inspected.

announcements.title: Ganesh Chaturthi Eco-Friendly Immersion Guidelines
announcements.description: Dedicated artificial immersion tanks set up near Central Park gate 2. Clay Ganesha idols only; no synthetic colors allowed into the society swimming pool or natural drainage lines.

announcements.title: Bi-Annual Underground Sump Desilting & Chlorination
announcements.description: Deep mechanical desilting and UV chlorination of 2,50,000 litre central reservoir completed. Water quality certified compliant with IS 10500 standards.

announcements.title: Christmas Carol & New Year Gala Night Pre-Registration
announcements.description: Join us for Christmas carol singing by resident children, live orchestra, and New Year welcome dinner at Central Park Clubhouse lawn. Food coupons registration opens Dec 1st.
